title: Post COVID Rehabilitation: Symptoms, tests, outcome
summary:
Post-COVID syndrome is described as having more than 200 possible symptoms and, because there is still no clear objective diagnostic test, it is diagnosed by excluding other conditions. This lack of precision makes diagnosis difficult and, together with the absence of effective treatment options, places a heavy burden on both patients and healthcare professionals. Fatigue remains the main symptom. It includes physical, cognitive, and emotional intolerance to exertion and often leads to long-lasting limitations in daily and work-related performance.
Since 2021, specialized rehabilitation programs have been developed in MediClin rehabilitation clinics, and symptoms, diagnostic findings, and test results have been systematically documented.
The aim of this project is to identify possible classifications of rehabilitation patients based on symptom patterns and clinical findings. This could enable more targeted diagnostic and treatment approaches, potentially supported by machine-learning algorithms. To achieve this, a new database and scoring system is required.
Existing data from more than 700 post-COVID patients treated in specialized rehabilitation clinics and 700 matched controls will be analyzed and compared with data from rehabilitation patients without post-COVID syndrome.
We hope that these clinical data will provide a basic for developing a new screening system and improving treatment strategies.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
SARS COV Infection with a positive test, symptom onset within 3 month after infection, symptoms lasting > 6 month
Exclusion criteria:
patients with stroke, multiple sclerosis, parkinson. dementia, not able to go, ICU treatment within the last 6 month.
